pre_command: rm -rf /Users/admin/Documents/benchmark_files/ && cp -r /Users/admin/Benchmark_Backup/benchmark_files /Users/admin/Documents && osascript -e 'tell application "Finder" to close windows'
instruction: I learned that Quicktime can record the screen, but I'm not exactly sure how to do it. Could you show me how to open QuickTime, then record a full-screen recording for a short duration and stop?
evaluator: [[ "$(system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType 2>/dev/null | grep Resolution | awk '{print $2 ", " $4}')" == "$(osascript -e 'tell application "QuickTime Player" to get natural dimensions of document 1' 2>/dev/null)" ]] && echo "True" || echo "False"
